scoring_justification: Cannot recompute barrier from raw NEB outputs in lightweight verifier; compare agent's reported barrier_lowering_meV to hidden paper-reported value (156 meV) with a tolerance (±50 meV) accounting for DFT method spread.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold barrier lowering (156 meV) for CO dimerization on Cu(100) with 2/16 ML OH coverage.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'CO2 electroreduction to ethylene via hydroxide-mediated copper catalysis at an abrupt interface' (Science, 2018) reports: 'lowering the energy barrier by 156 meV on Cu(100)'.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the paper's main text and supplementary figures.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The value is the paper's own reported number used to verify the agent's reproduction; not an invention.

outputs.description: Contains the computed activation energy barriers for CO dimerization on clean Cu(100) and on Cu(100) with 2/16 ML OH coverage, and the resulting barrier lowering in meV.

output_contract.notes: The barrier lowering is the difference clean_barrier - OH_barrier.

steps.description: Check that the computed barrier lowering in meV is within ±50 meV of the paper-reported value of 156 meV.
